pages.title: Wastelander
pages.text: Wastelanders cannot undergo any evolution. Only by repairing their meridians through special means can they begin the path of cultivation.$(br2)Here are three ways to become Human:

pages.title: Transformation Methods
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Heaven Cleansing Elixir$()$(br)Consuming it directly transforms you into the Human race.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Dream Realm Challenge$()$(br)When sleeping at night, there is a chance to enter a Dream Realm. Defeat the Wither Skeleton to succeed and become Human.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Break and Rebuild Manual$()$(br)A possible reward for deciphering an Ancient Book at a Scholar Table. Right-click it to become Human.
